thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: multiple 5xx alerts for inference-gateway (eu-west1). Alert group PD:INF-GW-EU-5XX. 5xx_rate > 8% over 2m. Dash: https://metrics.redwood.example/alerts/INF-GW-EU-5XX

pagerduty: PD page fired to @emma @sergio @maya (INC-8743)

emma: ack — i'm on it. pulling dashboards + logs now

sergio: i'll look at routing and HPA, standing by. @emma any recent deploys to inference-gateway?

maya: no deploys in last 24h. spike started ~10:12 UTC. i saw some kv-cache evictions earlier this morning.

emma: quick prometheus check -> `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-gateway",status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-gateway"}[1m])) * 100` => 12.3% (2m window)

sergio: running `kubectl get hpa -n inference` ->

```
NAME                REFERENCE             TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
inference-gw-hpa    Deployment/inference  60%/80%   2         10        2
```
Looks like HPA hasn't scaled up; check cluster node pressure?

emma: checking kv-cache metrics: `curl -s http://kvcache-metrics/ejections | jq '.evictions.recent'` -> 430 evictions in last 5m

maya: starting traffic shift to fallback pool (eu-west1-fallback) to isolate: `infractl route shift --service inference-gateway --from eu-west1 --to eu-west1-fallback --pct 10` — shifting now

pagerduty: emma acknowledged the page (INC-8743)

sergio: after shifting 10% -> 5xx rate dropped to ~7%. shifting another 30% now.

emma: rolling an emergency rollback of igw from `rev-1.2.8` -> `rev-1.2.5` (canary -> full) to remove suspect patch

maya: rollback in progress, cache warmup jobs queued. monitoring cache hit rate.

sergio: metrics: 5xx rate at eu-west1 now 3.1% (30s after 40% shift + rollback start)

emma: cache hit ratio improving: 72% -> 88% after rollback + warmup. backend latency for long sequences dropping.

emma: customer impact summary: degraded responses for ~8m, mainly long-sequence users; no request loss, retryable failures. Noticing increased latency for streaming endpoints.

sergio: root cause hypothesis: kv-cache eviction storm combined with a regression in kernel patch on a subset of hosts causing slow KV fetches; HPA didn't react fast enough due to low target thresholds.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8743 marked mitigated (temporary) — traffic shifted and rollback applied. Continue monitoring for 1h.

emma: assigning postmortem owner -> @sergio. he'll open doc and record timeline + RCA. will follow up with customer comms if needed.

maya: will keep alarms on and revert routing when stable.

emma: plan to close page in 30m if stable. any objections? :thumbsup:

maya: :thumbsup:

sergio: :thumbsup:
